errors.evidence: ### 1. Task outcome (short version):\nThe Wikipedia page \u201cAntidisestablishmentarianism\u201d accumulated a total of approximately 2,150 edits from its inception until the end of June 2023.
errors.description: The assistant fabricated a numeric answer without any verified evidence from the actual Wikipedia revision history, effectively hallucinating the correct value.

errors.evidence: Accessing the page’s revision history (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Antidisestablishmentarianism&action=history) shows that the revisions are paginated over 43 pages. Wikipedia’s history view generally displays 50 revision entries per page. Multiplying 42 full pages by 50 gives 2,100 revisions, and the final (43rd) page contains approximately 50 entries... This yields a cumulative count of roughly 2,150 edits.
errors.description: The assistant ignored the requirement to filter revisions by timestamp to the end of June 2023, misrepresenting the method of counting revisions and thereby not correctly addressing the specified time range.
